sn_aia_tool.description: Retrieves and verifies the authenticated caller's customer_contact record and linked customer_account (business) in the FSO banking data model. Searches by caller name, email, or business name. Returns contact details and account sys_id for downstream tool calls.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"caller_name":{"type":"string","description":"Full or partial name of the caller (searched against customer_contact.name)."},"business_name":{"type":"string","description":"Business/company name (searched against customer_account.name via account ref on customer_contact)."},"email":{"type":"string","description":"Caller email address (optional, searched against customer_contact.email)."},"phone":{"type":"string","description":"Caller phone number (optional, used as fallback)."}},"required":[]}
sn_aia_tool.name: Retrieve_Customer_Profile
